basic_info.description: Charming 4-bed, 2.5-bath Inner Richmond Edwardian with a wonderful blend of well-maintained period details and sophisticated contemporary updates. On the main floor is an elegant foyer, LR w/decorative fireplace and coved celling, and formal DR w/coffered ceiling, wainscoting, and original built-in w/stained glass. A functional mud room connects the foyer to the vaulted open kitchen and spacious family room which also flows from the DR, plus a powder room. Newly remodeled kitchen w/built-in breakfast area w/skylight, island, quartz countertops, Heath tile backsplash, brand new appliances, ample cabinet space and pantry closet. The family room opens to a well-sized deck with steps leading down to a landscaped, private backyard. Upstairs are 3 bedrooms and remodeled full bath with shower over tub, all flooded with natural light. Lower floor w/spacious contemporary en-suite w/modern full bath, office nook, large walk-in closet, and sliding glass doors leading to patio and backyard. Large 2-car garage w/abundant storage plus driveway parking. Located only 3 blocks from Golden Gate Park and 2 blocks from the celebrated restaurants and shops on Clement St. 95 Walk Score, numerous public transit options, and close to Park Presidio Blvd for easy access to Marin and points south.
